apps.description:
AiLagoon is the AI model hub pearl for Melusina. Register multiple LLM providers, manage per-model connections, and expose AI capabilities to other pearls via Grapple — all behind a single Melusina HTTP-out permission to the ai-lagoon sidecar.

## Why AiLagoon

- **Pinned inference transcripts** — cryptographically anchor any model conversation to your Solana wallet; transcripts are tamper-evident, citable across Pearls via Grapple, and verifiable independent of the operator
- **Single HTTP-out permission** — one security boundary; all provider traffic routes through the sidecar; you grant access once, revoke anytime
- **Wallet-rooted Grapple capability routing** — consuming Pearls request AI capabilities via Grapple; routing is scoped to the requesting Pearl; no cross-Pearl data leakage

## Supported Providers

- **Ollama** — local or remote Ollama server, any model it can host
- **OpenAI** — ChatGPT API (GPT-4o, 4-Turbo, o1, o3, 4.5, 4.6, newer models)
- **OpenRouter** — 100+ models from Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral, DeepSeek, and more through a single proxy

## Published Grapple Capabilities

Other Pearls request AI from AiLagoon via Grapple:

- `ai-text` — generic text / chat completion
- `ai-vision` — image understanding and OCR
- `ai-generic` — consumer picks a model in the Grapple UI at grant time
- Direct per-model — scoped to one provider + model; useful when a consumer wants a specific capability class (e.g., reasoning)

## Playground

A built-in chat playground lets you test any connected model without leaving the pearl — useful for validating credentials, checking capabilities, or prototyping prompts before calling them from another Pearl via Grapple.

## Status

*Shipped v0.7.0.* Production-ready AI model hub with Ollama, ChatGPT, OpenRouter; Solana-pinned inference transcripts.

apps.description:
BotMother is a Telegram bot manager with message routing and chatroom support, running on Melusina. Each bot configuration lives in its own Pearl — a sealed, per-document container with its own database, message history, and permissions.

## Why BotMother

- **Pinned chatroom snapshots** — cryptographically anchor any chatroom snapshot to your Solana wallet; snapshots are tamper-evident, citable across Pearls via Grapple, and verifiable independent of the operator
- **Per-bot Pearl isolation** — each bot runs in its own sealed container with separate storage, config, and message logs; no bot Pearl can see another unless you explicitly connect via Grapple
- **Wallet-rooted bot identity** — bot tokens and credentials stored locally; bot ownership linked to Solana wallet; non-repudiable access logs

## Features

- **Message Routing** — define rules to route incoming messages by command, keyword, or sender
- **Chatroom Support** — manage group conversations and route messages between channels
- **Grapple Connections** — link BotMother Pearls to other app Pearls — trigger actions in Bureau spreadsheets, pipe notifications into Mermail, or log events to MiniGit
- **Webhook Integration** — receive and process Telegram webhook events in real-time
- **Privacy-First** — all messages stay on your server; no third-party bot hosting; no message logging by others
- **Offline Queuing** — messages received while offline are queued and processed when the bot reconnects

## Setup

1. Create a bot via BotFather on Telegram
2. Copy the bot token
3. Create a new BotMother Pearl and paste the token
4. Define your routing rules
5. Your bot is live — routing messages through your own server

## Security Model

- Viewer — see bot status and message logs
- Editor — configure routing rules, manage chatrooms
- Admin — manage bot tokens, permissions, and Grapple connections

Every message, every routing rule, every bot token stays inside the Pearl. Server-side permission enforcement — no client-side trust.

## Status

*Production.* Free to install and use on your own server. No subscription, no per-message fees, no limits.

apps.description:
# Bureau

**Your office suite. Your server. Your rules.**

Bureau is a self-hosted office suite — four isolated workspaces that replace Google Docs, Sheets, Diagrams, and Photoshop for teams that refuse to hand their work to someone else's cloud.

Every spreadsheet, every document, every diagram, every image lives in its own sealed **Pearl** — a per-document container with its own storage, database, and permissions. No Pearl can see another unless you explicitly connect them via **Grapple**. That's not a setting — that's the architecture.

---

## 🆚 Why Bureau

| | Google / Microsoft | Bureau on Sandstorm |
|---|---|---|
| 🏠 **Where your data lives** | Their servers, their jurisdiction | Your server, your jurisdiction |
| 🔒 **Who can see it** | The vendor, their partners, hackers who breach them | Only people you explicitly share with |
| 🧱 **Isolation** | One breach exposes everything | Each Pearl is a sealed container — a breach in one stays in one |
| 🔗 **Connections** | Everything wired to everything behind the scenes | Nothing connects unless you Grapple it explicitly |
| 📡 **Offline** | Needs internet | Works air-gapped — every asset bundled |
| 💸 **Lock-in** | Try exporting from Google — it's a project | XLSX, CSV, PDF, JSON, HTML, PNG, SVG, XML — leave anytime |
| 👁️ **Tracking** | Analytics, telemetry, ad targeting | Zero. No phone-home. No CDNs. No tracking pixels |

---

## 📊 Spreadsheet

**The spreadsheet your accountant can actually trust.**

Multiple users edit the same sheet at the same time — every keystroke arrives in real time. Not "syncs eventually." Real time. Formulas, formatting, multiple worksheets, comments, merge cells, sorting, search, pagination — the full toolkit. Import your existing Excel files with styles and column widths intact. Export to XLSX, CSV, PDF, or JSON when you need to share outside.

| Capability | Details |
|---|---|
| 🤝 Collaboration | Simultaneous multi-user editing, live presence indicators |
| 🎨 Formatting | Fonts, colors, bold, italic, borders, alignment, fill, text wrap |
| 🔢 Formulas | A1 references, formula bar, cross-cell calculations |
| 📑 Worksheets | Multiple tabs — rename, reorder, add, delete |
| 🧩 Structure | Merge cells, freeze rows/columns, hide columns, multi-level sort |
| 💬 Comments | Per-cell threads with author attribution |
| 📥 Import | XLSX (preserves styles), CSV, JSON |
| 📤 Export | XLSX, CSV, ZIP (all sheets), PDF (per-sheet, ranges, page sizes), JSON |
| 📸 Snapshots | Named versions — save, browse, compare, restore |
| 📱 Mobile | Responsive layout, touch support, collapsible toolbar |
| 🌓 Themes | Light and Dark with keyboard toggle |

---

## 📝 Document

**Write together without conflicts — mathematically guaranteed.**

Bureau Documents use Yjs CRDT — a technology where simultaneous edits merge automatically without conflicts. Two people editing the same paragraph at the same time? Both edits survive. No "someone else is editing this" lockouts. No copy-of-copy-of-final-v2 chaos.

| Capability | Details |
|---|---|
| 🤝 Collaboration | Conflict-free CRDT sync — unlimited simultaneous editors |
| 🎨 Formatting | Bold, italic, underline, strikethrough |
| 📐 Structure | Headings (H1–H3), bullet lists, numbered lists, blockquotes, code blocks, horizontal rules |
| 📊 Tables | Insert and edit tables inline |
| 📂 Sections | Organize long documents into named sections |
| 📸 Snapshots | Named versions with one-click restore |
| 📤 Export | HTML |

---

## 📐 Diagram

**Flowcharts, org charts, and architecture diagrams — with the full draw.io engine.**

Not a simplified diagramming toy. The complete draw.io application, running inside your grain. Every stencil library. Every shape. Every connector. Flowcharts, UML, ER diagrams, BPMN, network topology, freeform drawing. One person edits at a time — everyone else sees changes appear live.

| Capability | Details |
|---|---|
| ⚙️ Engine | Full draw.io (mxGraph) — the same tool used by millions |
| 📊 Diagram types | Flowcharts, org charts, UML, ER, BPMN, network, freeform |
| 🧩 Shape library | Complete draw.io stencil collection |
| 🤝 Collaboration | Live viewer updates — edit lock with auto-acquire and auto-release |
| 📤 Export | XML, PNG, SVG, PDF |
| 📸 Snapshots | Named versions with restore |
| 📡 Offline | All draw.io assets bundled — no internet needed |

---

## 🎨 miniPaint

**Quick image editing without uploading your photos to someone else's server.**

Layers, filters, drawing tools, crop, resize, rotate — the essentials you need for graphics work without installing desktop software or trusting a cloud image editor with your files. Save snapshots before destructive edits. Export in any format you need.

| Capability | Details |
|---|---|
| 🖼️ Layers | Create, reorder, merge, manage |
| ✏️ Drawing | Pencil, brush, line, circle, rectangle, text |
| 🔧 Filters | Blur, sharpen, brightness, contrast, adjustments |
| 📐 Transform | Crop, resize, rotate |
| 📤 Export | PNG, JPG, BMP, WebP |
| 📸 Snapshots | Save state before destructive operations |

---

## 🔐 Security & Permissions

All Bureau Pearls enforce permissions **server-side** — not client-side hints. The server rejects unauthorized requests no matter what the client sends.

| Role | Capabilities |
|---|---|
| 👁️ **Viewer** | Read-only access — can browse but not modify |
| 💬 **Commenter** | Can add comments and annotations |
| ✏️ **Editor** | Full editing access to all content |
| 👑 **Admin** | Manage permissions, settings, and configuration |

> Every font, icon, library, and stylesheet is bundled. Bureau works with zero internet. No CDNs. No tracking. Nothing phones home. Ever.

---

## 💰 Pricing

**Free.** Install it on your server and use it. No subscription, no usage fees, no limits, no catch.

- **Operator-accountability through wallet signatures** — every wholesale-admin action (correspondent CRUD, rate-sheet edit, sub-account grant) is non-repudiable; the wholesale operator's Solana wallet signs the change. The audit log is provably theirs, not a vendor-database table they can claim was tampered with

## Topology

```
G-ccash Wholesale (this Pearl) ─── grants sub-account caps ──▶ G-organization (whitelabel partner)
     │                                                                   │
     ▼                                                                   ▼
finreact-sidecar                                                  G-popaye (operator console)

     ▼                                                                   drafts sends
Fineract GL                                                       emits envelopes
```

Clientspace is the client-portal Pearl for the Melusina ecosystem. Each client gets a sealed Pearl with their own storage, their own identity envelope, and their own per-Pearl Grapple grants — no shared database, no cross-tenant leakage, no operator backdoor.

- **Per-client Pearl isolation** — every client has their own filesystem, their own SQLite, their own keys; cross-client queries are physically impossible because there is no shared substrate

## How Operators Provision

1. The operator's admin Pearl claims a Clientspace install
2. Pick a client identity and generate a sturdyref
3. Hand the sturdyref to the client
4. From that point the operator has zero read access; the audit trail records that a Pearl was issued, never what the client put in it

## Suite Integration

Clientspace pairs with the Melusina Bureau suite (Notes, Docs, Sheets, Diagrams, Paint, Calendar, Contacts) as the per-client home for everything the client touches. Each Pearl can host its own Bureau Pearls, sealed inside the client's installation.

apps.description:
DueProcess is the configurable process and workflow engine for the Melusina ecosystem. Author a YAML template once — fields, panels, kanban columns, hooks, transitions — and any consuming Pearl renders the same flow with its own data. The engine itself is domain-agnostic; everything customer-specific lives in domain templates that ship and version separately from the engine.

## Why DueProcess

- **Pinned case state at any workflow step** — cryptographically anchor any case state transition to your Solana wallet; transitions are tamper-evident, citable across Pearls via Grapple, and provide an immutable audit trail of the case lifecycle, verifiable at any step
- **Hook allowlist per domain** — every typed event a process can fire is enumerated in a manifest; anything outside the allowlist fails closed at the engine boundary; no surprise side effects; security by default
- **Sub-procedure spawning with parent-blocks-on-child semantics** — a flow can require a child process to clear before it advances (KYC re-screening, four-eyes review, escalation paths); parent parks until child resolves; nested workflow composition

## How Consuming Pearls Integrate

A consuming Pearl claims DueProcess as a Grapple capability at boot, then asks the engine for a flow template by name. The engine returns the template; the Pearl renders the wizard against its own data (clients, transactions, documents, whatever the domain holds). Status reports flow one-way from the consumer back into DueProcess kanban; the engine never reaches into the consumer's data. PII stays where it lives; only opaque IDs and redacted display labels cross the wire.

## Features

- **Greenfield workflow authoring** — describe a process declaratively in YAML; no codegen, no compilation step, no versioned client SDK to bump
- **Domain-agnostic core** — the engine knows about steps, fields, hooks, and cases; it knows nothing about your business
- **Per-domain templates** — an MSB onboarding flow, a content review queue, a code change request, a clinical intake — each lives in its own templates folder and ships its own kanban vocabulary
- **Versioned templates** — version control your procedures; audit which version was active when each case progressed
- **Real-time updates** — WebSocket integration with consuming Pearls for live kanban updates

## Status

*Pre-release v0.1.0.* Currently powering the AITX Procedures station family; multi-domain validation in progress.

apps.description:
NamedCoin is the KYC onboarding Pearl for Melusina. Pass an identity and sanctions check once, and a time-boxed KYC attestation is recorded against your Solana wallet with a configurable expiry (90/180/365 days, up to five years). Every Melusina app that needs "is this person KYC'd?" probes the on-chain attestation — no re-upload, no storage of raw ID documents inside other Pearls.

## Why NamedCoin

- **Pinned KYC attestations as revocable, tradeable NFTs** — cryptographically anchor any KYC attestation to your Solana wallet; attestations are tamper-evident, citable across Pearls via Grapple, revocable at any time, and tradeable on-chain as NFTs
- **Merkle-tree selective disclosure** — raw ID images + questionnaire answers never leave the Pearl's encrypted store; what lands on-chain is a Merkle root over salted (key, value) claim leaves; apps verify individual claims (e.g., "residence is FR") with a selective-disclosure Merkle probe
- **Encrypted Pearl storage for raw IDs** — no leakage of raw identity documents; encrypted at rest; accessible only to authorized signatories via Grapple

## Features

- **Time-boxed attestations** — configure expiry (90/180/365 days or up to five years)
- **Sanctions list integration** — TeleScreen sidecar for real-time sanctions screening
- **Document authenticity + face matching** — AI Lagoon integration for document verification
- **Admin-side review** — KYC packet approval, sanctions list configuration, issue/revoke, consumer-trust editing
- **On-chain attestation** — attestation NFT lands on Solana; apps verify selectively without re-uploading

## Admin Pearl

Admin-side review and configuration lives in the companion admin Pearl: melusina-namedcoin-admin-app.

## Status

*Pre-release.* The pearl currently installs as a Coming Soon stub; the live KYC flow lands in v0.2.

apps.description:
TeleScreen is the screening Pearl of the Melusina ecosystem — sanctions lists, adverse-media checks, on-chain wallet risk, and PEP / AML compliance probes, all wrapped in a single Pearl with signed configuration, Grapple-scoped grants, and per-Pearl isolation. A complete install is three Pearls across two SPKs: a REST/JSON sidecar, an HTMX admin + member core Pearl (both in this SPK), plus the setup Pearl shipped as `telescreen-companion.spk` separately. Setup signs the trust bundle; core consumes it; sidecar verifies and serves.

## Why TeleScreen

- **Pinned screening-result snapshots** — every screening result (sanctions hit, adverse-media match, on-chain risk score) is pinned to the requesting Pearl's Solana wallet at the moment of issuance. Compliance teams later cite "this counterparty was OFAC-clean as of date X per a wallet-rooted, tamper-evident attestation" — not "our SaaS vendor told us so once and we trust the dashboard"
- **Per-screening-config Pearl isolation** — each screening list (custom OFAC profile, internal blocklist, partner-specific PEP set) lives in its own sealed Pearl with signed configuration. A breach or misconfiguration in one list cannot leak into another; revoking access to one does not impact the others. Melusina-shipped permission isolation, not application-layer ACLs
- **Grant-validated capability surface** — consuming Pearls (cca.sh, NamedCoin, Bureau apps doing client-onboarding) request screening via Grapple with scoped grants — "ai-text" / "ai-vision" / "screening-sanctions" / "screening-adverse-media". The grant is verified against the signed trust bundle at the Cap'n Proto boundary; bypass requires forging the bundle's cryptographic root, not sidecar credentials

## Architecture

- **REST/JSON sidecar** — sanctions + adverse-media + blockchain-risk APIs over signed gRPC
- **HTMX admin + member core Pearl** — bundle authoring, list management, partner-trust editing
- **Setup Pearl** (separate SPK: `telescreen-companion.spk`) — signs the trust bundle distributed to consumer Pearls

Deployment is `spk dev` / `spk pack`. Docker / direct system service paths are out of scope for the polished MVP.

## Status

*Pre-release v0.1.1.* REST surface + sanctions screening live; adverse-media and on-chain wallet-risk integrations follow in v0.2.

Vintage Remote Desktop gives every Melusina operator a disposable, full Linux desktop rendered in the browser. Pearls start in sandbox mode — every change is ephemeral and wiped when the Pearl closes. Click Save to upgrade the Pearl to a persistent, Solana-backed workspace.

## Why Vintage

- **Pinned session snapshots** — cryptographically anchor any desktop session to your Solana wallet; snapshots are tamper-evident, citable across Pearls via Grapple, and recoverable if the session crashes
- **Ephemeral-first sandbox** — by default, everything is temporary; persistence is an explicit choice, not a default; ideal for one-off work that shouldn't pollute your environment
- **Wallet-rooted persistent state** — when you click Save, session state is anchored to your Solana wallet; ownership and restoration tied to your key; no operator backdoor

## Ideal For

- One-off tooling that you don't want polluting your main environment
- Demo environments that reset cleanly
- Remote-ops consoles where persistence should be an explicit choice, not a default
- Isolated testing and experimentation

## Features

- **Full Linux desktop** — apt, gcc, git, Python, Node, Docker, and standard utilities
- **Browser-based** — no VNC client, no RDP software; open in any browser
- **File transfer** — drag-drop files into the desktop; export files back out
- **Clipboard sync** — paste between your computer and the remote desktop
- **Audio** — WebRTC audio support for VoIP and media playback
- **Offline-capable** — all assets bundled; no external calls

## Status

*Shipped v1.0.0.* Browser-based Linux desktop with ephemeral sandbox default, Solana-pinned session snapshots, full-featured toolchain.
